notes.title: SeaBed Audio Novel Collection Now Complete!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27773285/3ad45c34b6841884660a53fd462a64f9552046bf.jpg[/img]
Thank you for the wait! We're happy to announce that the SeaBed Audio Novel Collection is now complete with the release of Episode 3 "Silvergrass Station Cleaning"!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2184982/SeaBed_Audio_Novel_Collection__Episode_3__Silvergrass_Station_Cleaning/

[i]An unexpected visitor. A car ride. A quiet station.[/i]

[h2]Starring[/h2]
[list][*]    Mizuno Sachiko (Narrator & High Schooler): Kondo Yui
[*]    Takako: Matsui Eriko
[*]    Izuhana Midori: Aiya Saki
[*]    Weather Report, Coffee Shop Owner: Tokiwa Shouhei[/list]

We hope you have been enjoying the journey with the teenage goofball Takako and her handler, Sachiko!

Finally, an original short story [b]"Night Flight"[/b] by [b]Paleontology [/b]is now available as a free Extra Episode to owners of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/28481/SeaBed_Audio_Novel_Collection/]SeaBed Audio Novel Collection[/url]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2184983/SeaBed_Audio_Novel_Collection__Extra_Episode__Night_Flight

[i]The beginning of a journey. Private tutoring. Arrival.[/i]

[h2]Starring[/h2]
[list][*]    Kotani Fujika: Shioiri Asuka
[*]    Sakura Aoi: Kita Natsuki 
[*]    Coffee Shop Waitress: Maruyama Miki[/list]

All 4 episodes in the Audio Novel Collection have been written and directed by [b]Paleontology[/b], and beautifully illustrated by [b]Tonbu[/b].

Thank you for joining us on this journey and showing so much love for the game that it allowed us to produce these new scenarios together with [b]Paleontology[/b].

notes.title: SeaBed Audio Novel Collection Episode 1 Now Available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27773285/50e14bf77e292f953df9380827a76ecb51f99679.jpg[/img]

Thank you all SeaBed fans for your continued support over the years! It's made it possible for us to create something new again! We're now happy to announce a project where we were able to give voice to the game's beloved characters in an all-new story...

[h3]SeaBed Audio Novel Collection Episode 1 - "Brick Incinerator" is here![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2184980/SeaBed_Audio_Novel_Collection__Episode_1__Brick_Incinerator/
This Audio Novel Collection is a series of newly written audio novels for the beloved yuri-themed mystery visual novel.

Episode 1 contains:
[i]Meeting at the school. A strange incident. A scary story.[/i] (Length: 13:15)

The episodes are delivered in both a subtitled video format, and a Japanese audio-only track in .wav format.

The video supports Japanese, Japanese (closed captions), English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Korean subtitles which can be switched at will.

The new Audio Novel scenarios are written by [b]hide38 [/b]and directed by [b]AKIRA[/b], with beautiful key illustrations by [b]Tonbu[/b].

[h2]Starring[/h2]
[b]Sachiko [/b]has been given a cool and subtle voice by [b]Kondo Yui[/b], known as Biwa Hayahide in Uma Musume, Kiba Mikoto in Triage X, and Nath in 100% Orange Juice!

Meanwhile [b]Takako's [/b]silly antics are brought to life by [b]Matsui Eriko[/b] (Fuji Kiseki in Uma Musume, Maki Kyouko in Houkago Saikoro Club, Kokuyou in Tsugu Tsugumomo, Kamiya Nao in The iDOLM@STER Cinderella Girls)!

English Translation: [b]Andrew Hodgson[/b]
Chinese Translation: [b]Windyshine[/b]
Korean Translation: [b]Moonbi[/b]
    
The other 2 episodes + Extra episode of the collection will be released one by one over the coming months! 

We hope you can all enter into a wonderful year 2023 with this release!
